---
title: "Real single-sample workflow"
description: "A complete SCOP and Seurat workflow on the real pancreas_sub dataset: QC, doublets, layers, dimensions, cluster stability, UMAP, markers, and annotation checks."
---

This chapter executes a full construction path on `scop::pancreas_sub`, a real mouse pancreatic endocrinogenesis subset with 15,998 features and 1,000 cells. The object also contains spliced and unspliced assays for later trajectory work.

## 1 · Load and audit

```r
library(scop)
library(Seurat)

set.seed(20260807)
data(pancreas_sub, package = "scop")
srt <- pancreas_sub
DefaultAssay(srt) <- "RNA"

dim(srt)
Assays(srt)
table(srt$CellType)
```

## 2 · Measure QC and call doublets

```r
srt[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(srt, pattern = "^mt-")
srt <- db_scDblFinder(
  srt,
  assay = "RNA",
  db_rate = 0.01,
  verbose = FALSE
)

VlnPlot(srt, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"))
table(srt$db.scDblFinder_class)
```

Observed medians were 2,441 detected genes, 6,190 UMIs, and 0.6943% mitochondrial reads. `db_scDblFinder()` called 21 doublets.

![QC distributions before and after the recorded thresholds.](assets/figures/real-data/single-qc.png){fig-alt="Violin plots compare detected genes and mitochondrial percentage before and after QC in real mouse pancreas cells."}

The chosen thresholds fit this dataset’s observed range:

```r
keep <- with(srt[[]],
  db.scDblFinder_class == "singlet" &
  nFeature_RNA >= 1000 & nFeature_RNA <= 5000 &
  percent.mt < 5
)
srt <- subset(srt, cells = rownames(srt[[]])[keep])
```

This retained **979/1,000 cells (97.9%)**. The thresholds are recorded evidence, not universal defaults.

The exclusion audit is explicit: 21 doublets; 0 cells below 1,000 or above 5,000 detected genes; 0 cells at or above 5% mitochondrial reads; 21 unique cells excluded. Reasons are reported separately because they can overlap in other datasets.

### Doublets and ambient RNA are different problems

`db_scDblFinder()` is the verified default here. `RunDoubletCalling()` can route other supported callers when their dependencies and assumptions fit; compare score/class columns and run per sample. Ambient contamination is not solved by removing doublets: inspect suspicious cross-lineage markers and use `RunDecontX()` only with raw counts, suitable batches/background, and before/after marker checks.

## 3 · Join layers and construct the embedding

```r
srt <- JoinLayers(srt)
srt <- NormalizeData(srt, verbose = FALSE)
srt <- FindVariableFeatures(srt, nfeatures = 2000, verbose = FALSE)
srt <- ScaleData(srt, features = VariableFeatures(srt), verbose = FALSE)
srt <- RunPCA(srt, features = VariableFeatures(srt), npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE)
```

## 4 · Test clustering resolution

```r
srt <- FindNeighbors(srt, dims = 1:20, verbose = FALSE)
srt <- FindClusters(srt, resolution = c(0.2, 0.4, 0.8), verbose = FALSE)

ClusterTreePlot(
  srt,
  cluster_cols = grep("RNA_snn_res", colnames(srt[[]]), value = TRUE),
  title = "Resolution stability on real mouse pancreas"
)
```

![Cluster tree across resolutions 0.2, 0.4, and 0.8.](assets/figures/real-data/single-cluster-tree.png){fig-alt="Cluster tree shows stable and splitting clusters across three resolutions in the real pancreas dataset."}

Resolution 0.4 produced seven clusters and provides an interpretable middle point. A cluster tree does not choose resolution automatically; it shows where subdivisions appear.

## 5 · Estimate usable dimensions and run UMAP

```r
dims <- RunDimsEstimate(
  srt,
  reduction = "pca",
  method = "ensemble",
  min_dims = 5,
  verbose = FALSE
)
srt <- RunUMAP(srt, dims = dims, seed.use = 20260807, verbose = FALSE)
```

The executed ensemble estimate selected PCs **1–11**.

![UMAP of real mouse pancreatic cells coloured by bundled CellType.](assets/figures/real-data/single-umap.png){fig-alt="UMAP shows ductal, endocrine, Ngn3-high endocrine progenitor, Ngn3-low endocrine progenitor, and pre-endocrine cells."}

## 6 · Find markers and propose labels

```r
Idents(srt) <- srt$RNA_snn_res.0.4
markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  srt, assay = "RNA", only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0.2, logfc.threshold = 0.25
)

top_by_cluster <- markers |>
  dplyr::group_by(cluster) |>
  dplyr::slice_min(p_val_adj, n = 10)
```

For an internal check only, mapping each cluster to its majority bundled `CellType` agrees for **83.25%** of retained cells. This is not independent validation: the known labels come from the same bundled object.

## 7 · Save a restartable checkpoint

```r
saveRDS(srt, "checkpoints/03_clustered_pancreas.rds")
write.csv(markers, "results/cluster_markers.csv", row.names = FALSE)
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), "results/session-info.txt")
```

Next, use [cell annotation](annotation.qmd) to combine marker and reference evidence, or use the spliced/unspliced assays for a properly justified [trajectory analysis](advanced.qmd#trajectory-and-dynamics).

::: {.result-note}
**Result you can defend:** the real object passes a documented QC and doublet path, has stable structure across tested resolutions, and recovers the bundled developmental cell classes. **Result you cannot claim:** a new developmental discovery from this teaching subset.
:::
